items.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
items.summary: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI run amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

items.title: Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model
items.summary: Deepseek is open-sourcing DeepInfer, the inference framework behind its fast V4.1-Flash model. The vLLM-based system cuts compute costs and energy use when running AI models. The release adds more pricing pressure on Western providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. The article Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
items.summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

items.title: Sam Altman reportedly pitched three endgames for AI safety, one involving a single firm melting everyone else's GPUs
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman laid out three paths to safe AI in an internal presentation: an international watchdog modeled after the IAEA, a merger of the major labs into one entity, or a single company so powerful it could shut down everyone else's compute....

items.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
items.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations
items.summary: Elevenlabs' new Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models combine speed and accuracy. The v1 Max variant scores 98.8 percent on the Big Bench Audio benchmark with a 0.57-second response time. Elevenlabs says no model on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard is both faster and more accurate....

items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 Expands beyond Text to Support Code, Images, Video, and Audio
items.summary: Based on Gemma 4 and released under the Apache 2.0 license, Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 is a compact, open-weight, multimodal embedding model designed to make semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) more efficient while optimizing performance for on-device deployment. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
items.summary: Mistral AI launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system combines speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and a voice agent SDK, supports more than 50 languages, and lets agents tap into external tools during live conversations. It can run on your own infrastructure or through EU-hosted APIs to keep data under your control....

items.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.

items.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
items.summary: Meeting note-taking tool Otter.ai announced on Tuesday that it has raised $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund (CVF), which provides capital to startups without diluting equity and gets returns on the results of marketing spend. Otter.ai said that it will use these funds for enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion, and product innovation. […]

items.title: Presentation: Beyond the Prototype: Scaling Framework Agnostic AI Agent Infrastructure with Ray
items.summary: The speakers discuss transitioning AI agents from local FastAPI prototypes to resilient production systems on Kubernetes using Ray. They share operational insights on RayCluster topology, stateful memory handling, auto-scaling on dynamic traffic, and robust control plane designs, while highlighting critical guardrails, multi-region setups, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation pipelines....

items.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
items.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.
